title: DriverFile
description: The driver data file driver.kdl, read from KDL into this shape.

cli.description: The harness CLI the driver talks to, and the versions this data covers.

dataVersion.description: The driver data version, reported as `driver.data` on the agent (spec 6).

controls.description: How the agent can be driven; the first is the default. `native` when left out.

bindings.description: How many bindings one driver process serves; any number when left out (spec 30.5).

shims.description:
Version shims: folders whose files replace the egg's own for a range of harness
versions. The last listed range that holds the detected version wins (spec 31).

oneOf.description: A driver compiled into the runtime, served by `parrot driver <name>`.
A program in the egg's `parrot` folder, with a variant per platform when it is a binary.

run.description: The program, relative to the egg's `parrot` folder, when no variant matches.

variants.description: Per-platform programs; the first that matches wins.

os.description: The OS as Rust names it (`linux`, `macos`, `windows`); any when left out.

arch.description: The architecture as Rust names it (`x86_64`, `aarch64`); any when left out.

run.description: The program, relative to the egg's `parrot` folder.

versions.description: A semver range of the CLI versions this data covers, such as `>=2.0`.
A semver range of harness versions.

dir.description: The folder, relative to the egg's `parrot` folder.
